articles.title_en: The COVID-19 pandemic and unemployment: Evidence from mobile phone data from China
articles.title_cn: 新冠肺炎19大流行与失业：来自中国手机数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: Based on mobile phone records for 71 million users and location tracking information for one million users over almost three years, this study examines the labor market impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic in China’s Guangdong province, whose GDP is larger than that of all but the top 12 countries in the world. Using a standard difference-in-differences framework, our analysis shows dramatic and protracted effects of the pandemic on the labor market: it increased unemployment by 72% and unemployment benefits claims by 57% even after the full reopening in 2020 relative to their levels in the same period in 2019. The impact was also highly heterogeneous, with women, workers older than 40, and migrants being more affected. Cities that rely more on export or that have a higher share of the hospitality industry in GDP but a lower share of the finance and healthcare industries experienced a more pronounced increase in unemployment. The lingering impact likely reflects the global transmission of the pandemic’s effects through the supply chain and trade channels.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究基于近三年来71百万用户的手机记录和一百万用户的位置跟踪信息，研究了新冠肺炎19大流行对中国广东省劳动力市场的影响，该省的GDP高于世界上除排名前12国家之外的所有国家。使用标准的双重差分框架，我们的分析显示了疫情对劳动力市场的巨大而持久的影响：即使在2020全面重新开放之后，与2019同期水平相比，它仍使失业率增加72%，失业救济金申请增加57%。这种影响也具有高度的异质性，其中女性、年龄超过 40 的工人和移民受到的影响更大。更加依赖出口或酒店业占 GDP 比重较高但金融和医疗保健业比重较低的城市，失业率增长更为明显。这种挥之不去的影响可能反映出疫情的影响通过供应链和贸易渠道在全球范围内传播。

articles.title_en: The impact of minimum income on homelessness: Evidence from France
articles.title_cn: 最低收入对无家可归的影响：来自法国的证据
articles.abstract_en: In France, childless adults younger than 25 face hard-to-meet eligibility conditions to enroll in the minimum income program. The restrictive requirements generate a “jump” in the number of recipients at ages around 25. We use a Regression Discontinuity (RD) design to assess the impact of the French minimum income program (RSA) on users of accommodation and meal distribution services. We find that the RSA benefit reduces the homelessness rate by 20% among young adults aged 22 to 27. This result is driven by new RSA recipients who have started paying partial rent to third parties, and the probability of becoming a regular tenant increases after age 26. We simulate the effects of lowering the program’s minimum age eligibility on the probability of being homeless. Our findings suggest that in programs directed at homeless individuals, around 60% of expenditures are offset by savings in social assistance costs to the homeless.
articles.abstract_cn: 在法国，25岁以下的无子女成年人参加最低收入计划面临难以满足的资格条件。这些限制性要求导致25岁左右年龄段的受助人数出现“跳跃”。我们使用断点回归设计来评估法国最低收入计划（RSA）对住宿和膳食分发服务使用者的影响。我们发现，RSA福利使22至27岁的年轻人无家可归率降低了20%。这一结果是由开始向第三方支付部分租金的新RSA受助者推动的，并且在26岁之后成为常规租户的概率增加。我们模拟了降低该计划最低年龄资格对无家可归概率的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在针对无家可归者的计划中，约60%的支出被无家可归者社会救助成本的节省所抵消。

articles.title_en: Household sorting in an ancient setting
articles.title_cn: 古代环境中的家庭分选
articles.abstract_en: We use archaeological data from ancient settlements of three different historical eras on a Greek island to construct novel measures of consumption. Using these, we show that the shares of high-quality consumption goods were relatively more concentrated closer to the center of nucleated settlements as compared to low-quality consumption goods. There is no such pattern in a placebo settlement. In this unique setting, these quality gradients may reflect differences in household consumption baskets across these settlements. We argue that some alternative, trade or production based hypotheses for such gradients can be weakly ruled out based on our data and archaeological sources.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用希腊岛屿上三个不同历史时期古代定居点的考古数据，构建了新颖的消费度量。通过这些度量，我们表明，与低质量消费品相比，高质量消费品的份额相对更集中在聚居点中心附近。在安慰剂定居点中不存在这种模式。在这一独特环境中，这些质量梯度可能反映了这些定居点中家庭消费篮子的差异。我们认为，基于我们的数据和考古资料，可以弱排除一些基于贸易或生产的替代假说对这些梯度的解释。

articles.title_en: The impact of return migration on employment and wages in Mexican cities
articles.title_cn: 回流移民对墨西哥城市就业和工资的影响
articles.abstract_en: How does return migration from the US to Mexico affect local workers? Return migrants increase the local labor supply, potentially hurting local workers. However, having been exposed to a more advanced U.S. economy, they may also carry human capital that benefits non-migrants. Using an instrument based on involuntary return migration, we find that, whereas workers who share returnees’ occupations experience a fall in wages, workers in other occupations see their wages rise. These effects are, however, transitory and restricted to the city-industry receiving the returnees. In contrast, returnees permanently alter a city’s long-run industrial composition, by raising employment levels in the local industries that hire them.
articles.abstract_cn: 从美国回流到墨西哥的移民如何影响当地工人？回流移民增加了当地劳动力供给，可能损害当地工人的利益。然而，由于接触过更先进的美国经济，他们也可能携带有利于非移民的人力资本。利用基于非自愿回流移民的工具变量，我们发现，虽然与回流者职业相同的工人工资下降，但其他职业的工人工资上升。然而，这些效应是暂时的，且仅限于接收回流者的城市-行业。相比之下，回流者通过提高雇佣他们的当地行业的就业水平，永久性地改变了城市的长期产业结构。

articles.title_en: Locating Public Facilities: Theory and Micro Evidence from Paris
articles.title_cn: 公共设施的选址：理论与来自巴黎的微观证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel approach to evaluate location decisions for public facilities. The approach addresses, not only the standard distance-minimizing problem, but also the endogenous location decisions of individuals. The paper develops a quantifiable general equilibrium model with endogenous (residential and commercial) densities, housing prices, commutes to work, as well as to public/private facilities. The framework is applied to the case of secondary schools in Paris’ greater region at a 1km2 geographical scale. The analysis reveals that the observed location decisions made between 2001 and 2015 underestimate the endogenous reaction of individuals. A more decentralized strategy is predicted to increase welfare growth by 10 percent, reduce density in Paris’ center, and shorten commuting times to school globally.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提出了一种评估公共设施选址决策的新方法。该方法不仅解决了标准的距离最小化问题，还考虑了个体选址决策的内生性。本文构建了一个可量化的一般均衡模型，其中包含内生的（住宅和商业）密度、房价、通勤（包括上班和前往公共/私人设施）等因素。该框架应用于巴黎大区中学的案例，地理尺度为1平方公里。分析表明，在2001至2015期间观察到的选址决策低估了个体的内生反应。预测显示，一种更加分散化的策略将使福利增长提高10%，降低巴黎市中心的密度，并缩短全球范围内的上学通勤时间。
